content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Attendees ## slug: attendees ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End On the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} page, you can invite {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s to your {{variable.Object_Event}}. This can be done by searching for an {{variable.Object_Account}}, {{variable.Object_Contact}}, {{variable.Object_Campaign}}, {{variable.Object_Event}}, {{variable.Object_Lead}}, or Report! **Note:** If importing {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s from a summary or matrix report, the first column needs to be "{{variable.Object_Attendee}}: ID". ![Event Wizard Attendees 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Event%20Wizard%20Attendees%201.png){height="" width=""} ## Exiting the Event Wizard After filling in an {{variable.Object_Event}}’s information, there are two options; either click **Save & Publish Later** or **Save & Publish Now**. * If **Save & Publish Later** is clicked, the **Publish** button will be located at the top left. * If **Save & Publish Now** is clicked, the **Unpublish** button will be located at the top left. Attempting to close the {{variable.Component_EventWizard}} before an {{variable.Object_Event}}’s information has been saved will result in the following warning message. “You have unsaved changes. Before closing, click Save.”
